verdict.rationale: Airbyte has a dedicated 'schema-change-management' doc explaining that for each connection you can specify how Airbyte should handle source schema changes (e.g., propagate, ignore, pause), directly matching the policy-driven schema evolution story, and the Connection Timeline surfaces schema change events for visibility. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming these propagation policies work reliably in production and details on the specific policy options (e.g., auto-propagate columns vs. pause syncs).
